title: intuitive-game-design

summary.en: A game a first-time player understands with nobody explaining it — affordances, cognitive load, and the handful of milliseconds that decide whether an input feels good. Covers one-tap minimal games and web audio too.
summary.jp: 説明なしで初見の人が理解できるゲームの作り方。直感的な手がかりや認知負荷、入力の手触りを決めるミリ秒の調整までを扱う。ワンタップの小さなゲームと音の実装も含む。

mine: Compiled knowledge on affordances, cognitive load, natural mapping, and CARD/ORID playtest protocols
Compiled game-feel mechanics — variable jump, coyote time, input buffering, juice
Compiled web-audio implementation guidance — Web Audio API synthesis, Tone.js, look-ahead rhythm timing
